blocks.text:
On arrival at the airport, the team will meet you. The journey across the island and the ferry crossing to Puerto Ayora on Santa Cruz take about 1.5 hours.

On board the 50-metre superyacht, you will be welcomed by a crew of 16. The 1:1 guest-to-crew ratio allows each guest to receive attentive service. On the yacht, you will be introduced to Nikkei cuisine created by consulting chef Pedro Miguel Schiaffino.

In your free time, you can choose a snorkelling kit: a mask, fins, snorkel and an optional short wetsuit for your personal use throughout the week. As a welcome gift, guests receive a waterproof bag to keep their belongings dry during wet landings and a water bottle.

In the afternoon, you will visit the Darwin Station and the national park headquarters at the Fausto Llerena Breeding Center. The scientific team and expedition leaders will show you around the centre, introduce you to the giant tortoises and explain the conservation programmes for tortoises and land iguanas.

After the visit, there will be time to explore Puerto Ayora. You can stroll along the main waterfront and browse the boutiques and jewellery shops. In the evening, talks about the journey ahead will take place on the yacht, and at dinner you can sample fresh Galapagos seafood.
